title: Frederick Wolfe, German POW shot at Fort Knox

tellings.quote: he was a German soldier who after World War II was sent to Fort Knox as a prisoner of war.

plain: A former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, tells of a man called Frederick Wolfe. According to Mowatt-Larssen, Wolfe was a German soldier who was sent to Fort Knox, a US Army base in Kentucky, as a prisoner of war, and the story as it is filed says he was shot there around 1944. Mowatt-Larssen gives no source for the account.
